baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Orcs & Goblins (Savage Orcs of the Southlands jungles: tribes led by Big Bosses and Shamans, fetish-and-war-paint cultists); TW:WH Wurrzag
baseline.why: Savage Orc tribes are the same warband package as other greenskins at tier 7 (no technology), led by a Big Boss and a shaman

temple_city.source: canon: WFB 8e Lizardmen army book (Slann Mage-Priests rule temple-cities through Skink priests, Saurus spawn as the warrior host, isolated by the Old Ones' design)
temple_city.why: Lizardmen temple-cities are ruled absolutely by a Slann theocracy with a Saurus warrior caste
